messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up: RippleHealth trial starts Monday. Theyre doing clinician-assist demos with lots of short interactive edits. Need a one-page, customer-facing runbook that balances instant feel (streaming) with cost controls. Draft below 
Owen (SRE): Awesome — key ops constraints?
Marta (AE): Theyre on a tight pilot budget. Renewal hinge will be cost per consult. If unit economics look bad, we lose them.
Tariq (EngOps): Pattern that has worked: lightweight prefix caching for repeated system prompts, streaming for UI, and server-side debounce for rapid-fire edits.
Lina (CS): Customer-facing runbook (concise):
- Prep: share sample prompts (well prefill top 10 via the prefill API).
- Warmup: reserve 1 GPU warm pool for first 72h and run 50 scripted sessions to avoid cold tokens.
- Streaming: enable streaming for interactive flows; client should append chunks and show interim status.
- Debounce: advise client to debounce keystrokes to 300ms to avoid token storms.
- Caching: prefix-cache system prompts (TTL 8h). Hash user session + prompt template for keys.
- Fallbacks: circuit-breaker -> quantized model + reduced batch size when util > 70% or p95 > 900ms.
- Cost guardrails: per-session token cap = 15k tokens; daily account cap = $400 (AE notify).
- Telemetry: ensure routes emit token_count, model_variant, latency_ms, and cache_hit boolean.
- Escalation: oncall SRE, EngOps lead, AE (see contact block).
Owen (SRE): Add ops snippet for automated fallback rule: 
```json
{
  "customer": "ripplehealth",
  "rules": [
    { "metric": "util_pct", "operator": ">=", "value": 70, "action": "switch:gpt-q4-small" },
    { "metric": "p95_latency_ms", "operator": ">", "value": 900, "action": "reduce_batch:0.5" }
  ]
}
```
Marta (AE): For renewal risk: weekly health email with cumulative spend + top 5 journeys usage. If 3-day rolling avg > forecast by 25%, we schedule cost review call.
Tariq (EngOps): Also include a quick how-to for customers to enable client-side streaming safely:
1) Open streaming connection with a short handshake (send session metadata).
2) Render partial tokens as they arrive, but suppress final save until full response or explicit user accept.
3) Abort inflight requests when user cancels; notify server to release KV cache slot.
Lina (CS): Customer-facing one-pager will go into Confluence and be emailed to PM and AE pre-launch. Ill draft the email template for cost alerts.
ops-bot: Runbook created: /cs-runbooks/ripple-trial-streaming-safety-onepager - https://confluence.internal/ripple-trial-runbook
Owen (SRE): Will add rollback commands and kubectl snippets for manual failover.
Marta (AE): Ill attach the billing thresholds and draft the renewal play in the runbook.
Lina (CS): Thanks team. Tagging this thread for quick lookup during the handoff call on Friday.
